final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_list_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_across_media_types FROM media_averages) SELECT media_type_name, average_list_price, average_bytes_per_millisecond, average_bytes_per_millisecond / average_across_media_types AS relative_average FROM media_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_across_media_types IS NOT NULL
